item.title: Stable Reports To Stewards - Autumn Surf (Warwick Farm Wednesday)
item.description: Please note the following: WARWICK FARM (Wednesday 18th February) Race 1, No.7 - AUTUMN SURF: The Clarry Conners stable reported the gelding has undergone tie-back surgery since its first trial (10/12/24). The 3yo has since trialled on three occasions (Warwick Farm 9/01/2026, 22/01/26 & 3/02/26).

item.title: Orange Cup Will Now Be Run Over 1600m
item.description: Please note the Orange Cup historically run at 2100m will now be conducted over 1600m (and going forward) with the Cup meeting scheduled for Friday 17th April.
